exclusion_reason: UR-Recomp uses the command-line runtime. GUI code is manual-only; upstream bin wrappers are replaced by deterministic project launchers; upstream tests include an unrelated ROM fixture and are not part of the runtime closure.

project_patch.purpose: Numeric --empty-fill parsing and robust unknown/missing decoder-type validation.

install_contract: Stage pristine vendored source, apply the existing hash-checked UR-Recomp patch, install repository-owned PyYAML pure Python, then copy snes2asm and generate console launchers using tools/install_pure_python_tool.py.
